title.narrative: Responding to menstrual health and protection related needs of women and girls affected by floods in Mandalay, Shan, Kayin and Bago East

description.narrative: This project aims to provide women and girls a sense of dignity and empowerment during stressful times after the floods. Often, the menstrual health and protection-related needs of women and girls are overlooked and undervalued during emergency situations while immediate needs related to food and shelter tend to be prioritized. Nonetheless, if these are not met, it could have a negative impact on their (reproductive) health, well-being and even on the access to humanitarian assistance and other basic services and opportunities. UNFPA and partners will specifically address these needs of women and girls by distributing dignity kits and women's essential items in Mandalay, Shan, Kayin and Bago East.
